Spinal Decompression for Herniated Disc

Testimonial spinal-decompression disc-herniation back-pain chiropractic

Evidence: testimonial

Summary

A patient with a herniated L4-L5 disc avoids surgery after completing a 16-session spinal decompression protocol.

Subject Type: therapy

Subject ID: therapy_003

Experience

An MRI showed a herniated disc at L4-L5 with significant nerve compression. My surgeon said I needed surgery. Instead, I tried spinal decompression. After 16 sessions over 6 weeks, my sciatica was gone. A follow-up MRI showed the disc fragment had retracted. I avoided surgery entirely.

Outcome

Sciatica resolved; follow-up MRI showed disc fragment retraction; surgery avoided.

Date: 2023-11-30

Verified: Yes

Rating: 5 / 5

Location: Texas, USA
